headline: Lykos, Tempest and DeadLands See Fresh Strongpoint Changes
war_summary: Since the noon dispatch, fighting has centred on Lykos Isle, where strongpoints Fort Guile and The Squall have changed hands repeatedly; seven ownership events were logged in the last two hours and twenty-two in the last day. Tempest Island has also rekindled, with Blackwatch and Surge Gate entering the log again, while the DeadLands, quiet at the last edition, has returned to the board with two fresh ownership events about 13:25. Godcrofts and The Fingers, lively earlier, have grown quiet; no event has been recorded there since mid-morning. Farranac Coast and Fishermans Row likewise remain still in strongpoint ownership, though Farranac continues to burn with heavy casualties. The great casualty mills of Weathered Expanse, Stlican Shelf, and Marban Hollow still grind on without a single strategic base changing hands. As the war enters day ninety-five, no side has yet reached the thirty-four required victory towns.
